{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Mission Parameters

|serverExec= server

|descr= Sets time of the day to the hour. Minutes will always be zero.

|s1= datetime call [[BIS_fnc_paramDaytime]]

|p1= datetime: [[Number]] or [[Array]] - (Optional, default [[dayTime]]):
* [[Number]] - day hour. This will set the hour '''in the same day''' (unless 23 < ''hour'' < 0).<br>Float numbers are [[floor|floored]]
* [[Array]] - [[dayTime]] format: [year, month, day, hour, minute]
&nbsp;

|r1= [[Array]] - set date

|x1= <sqf>private _date = 12 call BIS_fnc_paramDaytime;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _date = [2001, 01, 01, 12, 00] call BIS_fnc_paramDaytime;</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>private _date = call BIS_fnc_paramDaytime;</sqf>

|seealso= [[dayTime]] [[date]] [[setDate]] [[Mission Parameters]]
}}
